subtasks.title: Parse the LAST fenced ```answer block (strict JSON, byte-match)
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: plan/005_af804251f18d/architecture/sidechat-contracts.md §SIDECHAT-004 — LAST block in a COMPLETED reply (streaming partials never parse), strict JSON, choice values must BYTE-match an option value, malformed → in-view notice + chat stays open.
2. INPUT: frozen assistant reply text from P1.M1.T5.S2 + the question's option value set (from the same state shapes the panel renders).

LOGIC: `parseAnswerBlock(replyText, optionValues)`: find ALL fenced blocks whose info string is exactly `answer`; take the LAST; strict JSON.parse of the body; `{"value": v}` valid iff v byte-matches (===) an option value; `{"text": t}` valid for write-in/text questions (non-empty); anything else (missing block, malformed JSON, unknown shape, non-matching value) → `{kind:"none", reason}` where reason feeds the in-view notice (P1.M2.T1.S2). Pure function — no engine state. Tests: last-block-wins with multiple blocks; byte-match strictness (case/whitespace mismatch → none); malformed JSON → none+reason; empty text → none; valid value and valid text shapes.
4. OUTPUT: ParsedAnswer union consumed by P1.M1.T6.S2.
5. DOCS: none — pure internal function; the protocol text itself lives in the system prompt (P1.M1.T4.S2).
